stops.note: eistedd 'sit' + bod 'be', a session; the Lord Rhys held a famed contest of poets and musicians at Cardigan Castle in 1176, often called the first eisteddfod
the gatherings were revived around 1800 with Iolo Morganwg's Gorsedd of Bards, and the National Eisteddfod has been held yearly since 1861

current_meaning: a Welsh festival of music, poetry and literature
